# cadrender

> Fast renderer that turns CAD drawings (DXF, and DWG read directly) into PNG and SVG pictures, one per sheet (paper-space layout tab). Rust library, Python package (`pip install cadrender`) and command line tool. About 10 ms per sheet; roughly 470x faster than ezdxf + matplotlib. No ODA converter or AutoCAD needed. MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Use cadrender when a task needs previews, thumbnails or images of DXF/DWG files, especially many files or many layout tabs. It does not edit or write DXF/DWG; it only reads and draws them. For editing CAD data use ezdxf; for pictures use cadrender.

## Python

```python
import cadrender

doc = cadrender.open("drawing.dwg")        # .dxf or .dwg; reads the file once
doc.sheets                                 # ['A01', 'A02', ...] layout tab names in tab order
png = doc.render("A01", width=2000)        # bytes (PNG); format="svg" gives SVG bytes
doc.render_to("A01", "out/A01.svg")        # format from the file extension
summary = doc.render_all(
    "out/", width=2000, formats=("png", "svg"), threads=4,
    sheets=["A01", "A03"],                 # optional subset of tabs
    clean={"layers": ["TITLE_BLOCK"], "block_keywords": ["logo"]},  # leave things out
)
summary["done"], summary["failed"]         # lists / dict of errors per sheet
doc.sheet_info()                           # [{"sheet", "order", "paper": {...}}] in tab order
doc.attributes("A01")                      # [{"sheet", "block", "layer", "handle", "position", "values": {TAG: value}}]
doc.texts("A01", layers=["NOTES"])         # [{"sheet", "layer", "type", "handle", "text", "position"}] plain text
```

Option keywords for render/render_to/render_all: preset ("preview" default: grey on white, paper lineweights; "none": true colours), width, dpi, color ("mono" | "true"), background, lineweight, frame ("extents" | "paper"), margin, max_height, full_detail, clean, draw_order, text_masks, wipeout_frames. Output file names in render_all: `<file stem>__<sheet>.png`.

## Command line

```sh
cadrender sheets drawing.dwg
cadrender attribs drawing.dwg [--sheet A01] [--json]
cadrender render drawing.dwg --sheet A01 --width 2000 -o a01.png
cadrender render drawing.dxf --all --out-dir out/ [--sheets A01,A02] [--threads N] [--svg]
```

`render --all` prints a JSON summary with the time of each sheet. Options: --preset preview|none, --color mono|true, --frame extents|paper, --no-clean, --full-detail, --no-wipeout-frames, --font auto|liberation|FILE.ttf.

## Rust

```rust
use cadrender::{load_fonts, Document, FontChoice, RenderOptions};
let doc = Document::open("drawing.dxf", load_fonts(&FontChoice::Auto)?)?;
let opts = RenderOptions::preset("preview").unwrap();
let prep = doc.prepare(&opts);
for sheet in doc.sheets() { std::fs::write(format!("{sheet}.png"), doc.render_png(sheet, &opts, &prep)?.png)?; }
```

## What it supports

DXF (ASCII) and DWG R2004 to R2018; paper-space viewports (clip, per-viewport frozen layers, scale, twist); lines, arcs, polylines, splines, helix; hatches (pattern, solid, gradient, islands); TEXT, MTEXT with formatting, attributes; dimensions, LEADER, MULTILEADER; blocks and nested inserts; WIPEOUT; IMAGE (PNG/JPEG next to the drawing); REGION/3DSOLID outlines; linetypes, lineweights, draw order. Fonts: Arial if installed, else bundled Liberation Sans (no AutoCAD fonts).
